name: Carga stab sub
desc: Kuduro sub in F# minor: raw syncopated sine stabs with a hard pitch-drop knock on every onset, punching around the four-floor kick like a carga MC's bounce, octave jumps at phrase ends. Angolan energy, festival-rig weight.

code.full: note("<[f#1 ~ f#1 ~ ~ f#1 ~ ~] [f#1 ~ f#1 ~ ~ e1 ~ ~] [f#1 ~ f#1 ~ ~ f#1 ~ ~] [a1 ~ a1 ~ ~ e1 ~ b1]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(18).pdec(.04).attack(.004).decay(.28).sustain(.2).release(.08).shape(.55).lpf(800).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[f#1 ~ f#1 f#2 ~ f#1 ~ f#2] [f#1 ~ f#1 ~ e1 e2 e1 ~] [f#1 ~ f#1 f#2 ~ f#1 ~ f#2] [a1 a2 a1 ~ e1 e2 b1 b2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(20).pdec(.035).attack(.003).decay(.25).sustain(.18).release(.07).shape(.6).lpf(900).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
